newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST-Nycomed Q1 pre-tax seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Nycomed Q1 pre-tax seen lower.

text.p: Norwegian pharmaceuticals company Nycomed ASA is expected to book pre-tax profits in the first quarter of 280 million crowns, according to a Reuter poll of eight domestic and international analysts.
In the first quarter 1996, Nycomed posted a profit before tax of 402 million crowns.
Seven of the analysts recommended holding the share, while one said buy.
The analysts said they expected no great surprises from the Norwegian drugs group. "The figures are not especially difficult to predict," commented one analyst.
Others said the market's reaction would depend on the outlook for the group given by Nycomed chairman and CEO Svein Aaser when he presents the results on Monday at 0700 GMT.
"The market situation in the United States is still important, but it won't just be the figures that affect the share price, what Aaser says for the future will also count," said another analyst.
The impact of the cost-cutting programme Fokus 98 and development of the specialty ultrasound area were two other important areas, they said.
